Phase-2.name: Cart
Phase-2.goal: Compose money and catalog into a validated shopping cart with deterministic totals.

scope.in-scope: The modules listed in this phase and their verification files.
scope.out-of-scope: Modules owned by other phases; this phase must not edit them.

assumptions.assumption-1: The docs/graph-index.xml module list is the single source of truth for ids.
assumptions.assumption-2: Every module in this phase has a verification file before implementation starts.
assumptions.assumption-3: The previous phase is complete and its exit criteria are recorded as evidence.

dependencies.dependency-1: docs/verification-index.xml entries for the phase modules.
dependencies.dependency-2: Repository-level mygrace.config.json size budgets and index caps.

step-1.description: Implement addItem/subtotalCents/renderSubtotal with quantity and stock validation.
step-1.acceptance: Cart totals are exact integer cents; invalid quantity, unknown product and insufficient stock all throw.

verification-plan.verification-1: V-M-CART — run the module checks and record the digest.
verification-plan.verification-final: Phase exit: mygrace lint --path . reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.

risks.risk-1: Quantity accumulation can silently overflow stock if validation happens after storage.
risks.risk-2: Totals must reuse the money module so formatting and arithmetic cannot drift.

observability.marker-rule: Every module logs [Module][function][BLOCK_NAME] on validation failures.
observability.digest-rule: Verification failures are compacted into .mygrace/last-failures.md for the agent loop.

evidence.evidence-1: bun test src/cart/index.test.ts — accumulation, three failure modes, end-to-end total.

exit-criteria.criterion-1: All listed module tests pass with failure paths covered.
exit-criteria.criterion-2: mygrace lint reports 0 errors and 0 warnings for the touched artifacts.
exit-criteria.criterion-3: Index and per-entity files agree on every field after the phase.
exit-criteria.criterion-4: No generated file outside this phase's scope changed.

rollback.rollback-1: Revert the phase commits; the indexes are the only cross-file coupling.
rollback.rollback-2: Re-run lint to confirm index/entity consistency after a rollback.

Phase-2.notes: This phase is generated deterministically; edit scripts/gen-example.ts, not the output. The demo exists to exercise lint, verify, measure-context and the MCP tools end to end. Size budgets from mygrace.config.json defaults are respected deliberately.
